image_description: An interior view of a lumbermill or sawmill facility. The image features a long, rough-hewn wooden plank moving along a conveyor track system towards the viewer. To the left is heavy green industrial machinery with gears and levers. In the background, there are stacks of processed lumber, vertical log supports, and structural steel beams. The lighting is natural but dim, typical of an industrial workshop.
